title: Milestone 2026.04.54 Operational Retrospective — Full Analysis

slowest_experiments.title: Conductor timeout watchdog — RETRO-003

Nine appearances times 31 min foregone savings equals 279 min of accumulated deferred optimization with a confirmed fix — the full savings were never realized.

slowest_experiments.title: Live 100q Precision v8 — RETRO-033 eighth attempt, RETRO-033 closure attempt
slowest_experiments.root_cause: FIRST appearance in the slowest-5. Exp 527 replaced Exp 346 (55M-param training, retired via Exp 703) in the .54 slowest-5. Live 100-question inference benchmark consuming approximately 52 min due to sequential model loading and single-question batching. RETRO-033 (verify-repair never shows positive improvement) has been the longest-open RETRO in the project series; this is the eighth attempt. If Exp 527 re-enters .55 slowest-5, immediate analysis is required: either apply BatchedInferenceRunner (8q batches) or resolve RETRO-033 and retire the experiment class. First-appearance threshold is one milestone; second appearance triggers mandatory optimization review.

slowest5_composition_change.note: First slowest-5 composition change since milestone .48 (when Exp 383 entered). Exp 346 exited after 5 milestones via Exp 703 retirement. Exp 527 entered for the first time. The four persistent entries (425, 410, 383, 380-382) are all retired in .54 via Exp 703 and will NOT recur in .55.

bottlenecks_identified: GOVERNANCE CRITICAL RESOLVED IN .54: All 7 legacy slow experiments (346, 380, 381, 382, 383, 410, 425) confirmed retired in Exp 703 preflight v6. This single action eliminates approximately 316-380 min of recurring overhead per milestone starting .55. The exclusion manifest governance failure spanning 18 milestones (Exp 425) is now formally closed. The improvement deceleration trend will likely REVERSE in .55: from -48 min (-1.2%) in .54 to an estimated -300+ min (-7.8%+) in .55 based on the retirement math alone.

SLOWEST-5 PERSISTENCE PATTERN RESET BUT NEW ENTRY REQUIRES IMMEDIATE ATTENTION: Exp 527 (Live 100q Precision v8, 52 min, RETRO-033 eighth attempt) entered the slowest-5 for the first time in .54. If it recurs in .55 without optimization, the governance failure pattern resets with a new champion. Apply BatchedInferenceRunner(batch_size=8, batch_timeout_s=480) to Exp 527's inference loop before .55 begins, or retire it if RETRO-033 is formally closed. First-appearance threshold means .55 is the last chance to prevent Exp 527 from becoming the next multi-year slowest-5 anchor.

WALL TIME IMPROVEMENT DECELERATION APPROACHING FLOOR WITHOUT STRUCTURAL INTERVENTION: The improvement series shows .52: -248 min, .53: -74 min, .54: -48 min (80.6% deceleration over two milestones). Without the retirement of the 7 legacy experiments, the natural floor would be approximately 3,800-3,850 min. WITH the retirement, the new floor is approximately 3,500-3,550 min. To sustain the improvement series past .55, at least one of the following must be implemented: BatchedInferenceRunner for Exp 527, incremental test selection, or DualGPU opportunity scheduling.

PRE-FLIGHT TEST SUITE OVERHEAD — FOURTEENTH CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE UNRESOLVED: At 562 experiments, the full pytest suite consumes approximately 562 min (14.6% of wall time). This is now the single largest recoverable overhead in the milestone, exceeding the soon-to-be-retired slowest-5 combined (316 min) by 78%. Incremental test selection has been recommended for 14 consecutive milestones without implementation. The test suite is now growing at 12 experiments per milestone, compounding the problem. Without implementation, .55 test overhead will reach approximately 574 min (14.8%) — likely overtaking any wall time gains from the legacy retirements.

JEPA STILL BELOW RANDOM — THIRD CONSECUTIVE FAILED RETRAIN: Exp 704 confirmed jepa_v17_ood_auc=0.4819 (vs v16=0.4759, v15=0.4751). The JEPA cascade (Tier 2) has been blocked for three consecutive retrains. Exp 705 specced v18 with LambdaRank listwise loss (rank all steps jointly, optimize NDCG surrogate). This is a distinct architectural hypothesis from RankNet (v17) and contrastive pairs (v16). Before scheduling v18 training, audit the current positive/negative pair labels in the training data to verify no anti-correlation persists. A third consecutive failure with a new loss function but the same corrupted training data will not advance the research.

PSV PACORE DEGRADING FOR SECOND CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE: Exp 709 (psv_pacore_slope=0.001212) confirms psv_pacore_improving=false. Exp 697 in .53 (slope=0.004242) first identified the reversal from .52's improving trend. The degradation is slowing (slope fell 71%) but remains negative. Two consecutive cycles of degrading PSV with no intervention means the self-play loop is consuming compute without improving the verifier. A corpus distribution audit is mandatory before .55 schedules any PSV iteration.

DISTILLATION IMPROVING BUT BELOW GATE — TWO EXPERIMENTS INVESTED: Exp 710 achieved distillation_auroc_v2=0.8747 (improved from Exp 690's 0.7995 in .53). Progress is real (+0.0752 delta) but the gate remains at 0.90. At this trajectory (+0.075/experiment), one more experiment should cross the gate. However, each distillation run consumes 3,000-6,000 seconds of teacher inference. Teacher inference time budget must be validated before v3 run: if the teacher model is loaded cold, allow 60 min warmup before any benchmark. The gate has now been tested twice; a third miss would confirm a fundamental architecture ceiling.

GPU 1 IDLE AT CLOSE — THIRTEENTH CONSECUTIVE MILESTONE: Both GPUs idle at close: GPU 0 at 54C / GPU 1 at 44C, 10C thermal differential. GPU 1 performed zero compute work during the entire milestone. The DualGPU infrastructure (Exp 684-685, .52 cycle) has been validated for three consecutive milestones but never deployed to production training. With the 7 legacy experiments now retired, the next largest GPU time sinks will be new joint retrains and inference experiments. DualGPU opportunity scheduling must be built into the conductor for .55.

BLOCKED EXPERIMENT CONSUMING QUEUE SLOT: Exp 714 (NPU AMD XDNA, blocked) consumed a queue slot without research output for the second consecutive milestone. NPU unblock path (IRON toolchain install) is a multi-hour system-level operation. Until Vivado and the IRON toolchain are confirmed installed and tested, NPU experiments should not be queued. Add a tool_available pre-check gate to the conductor before any experiment that requires non-standard tooling.

CONDUCTOR LOG RETRO ANALYSIS LATENCY: The conductor-generated Exp 715 artifact covers only the 12-cycle experiments (24.32 min). The full milestone analysis (3861 min, 562 experiments) requires a separate human/AI pass that takes 15-20 min. The gap between conductor artifact and full retro represents structural information not captured in automated tooling. A lightweight experiment-level timing log written by the conductor during execution would enable automated full-milestone retro construction without the manual analysis step.
improvements_suggested: PRIORITY 1 — APPLY BATCHEDINFERENCERUNNER TO EXP 527 BEFORE .55 BEGINS: Exp 527 (Live 100q Precision v8, 52 min) just entered the slowest-5. This is the only window to prevent it from becoming the next multi-year slowest-5 anchor. Apply BatchedInferenceRunner(batch_size=8, batch_timeout_s=480) to the inference loop. Expected reduction: 52 min to approximately 10-13 min. If RETRO-033 is formally closed (verify-repair permanently retired), add Exp 527 to the exclusion manifest instead.

IMPLEMENT INCREMENTAL TEST SELECTION — FOURTEENTH CONSECUTIVE RECOMMENDATION AND NOW THE TOP WALL-TIME LEVER: The 7 legacy retirements free approximately 316 min. The test suite consumes 562 min. If legacy retirement savings are reinvested into faster tests, net wall time may not improve. Replace unconditional 'pytest tests/python' with module-scoped selection: 'pytest tests/python/test_<changed_module>.py' for experiments that modify a single python/carnot/ subdirectory. Estimated savings: 275-375 min per milestone. This is now the largest single recoverable overhead.

JEPA v18: AUDIT TRAINING DATA LABELS BEFORE SCHEDULING TRAINING: Three consecutive retrains (v15, v16, v17) all produced OOD AUC near 0.48. Exp 705 specced LambdaRank listwise loss for v18. Before running training: (1) sample 20 positive pairs and 20 negative pairs from the training corpus and manually verify labels; (2) confirm the data pipeline does not invert labels during batch construction; (3) compare training loss curve for first 100 steps — if loss goes UP, labels are inverted; stop immediately. A training data audit costs 30 min; a fourth failed retrain costs 3+ hours.

PSV PACORE: CORPUS DISTRIBUTION AUDIT BEFORE .55 ITERATION: Two consecutive milestones of degrading FP rate (Exp 697 slope=0.004242, Exp 709 slope=0.001212). Before scheduling any .55 PSV iteration, compare: (1) held-out FP rate vs training FP rate (detect overfitting); (2) Exp 709 corpus distribution vs Exp 697 corpus to identify drift; (3) hyperparameter stability (learning rate, K=2 pairs per self-play round). The degradation slope is decreasing but remains negative — a possible sign of convergence to a local minimum rather than divergence. Do not schedule additional PSV iterations without this audit.

DISTILLATION v3: VALIDATE TEACHER WARMUP BEFORE TIMING RUN: Exp 710 achieved AUROC=0.8747, within 0.0153 of the 0.90 gate. The v3 run should close the gate. Before starting: (1) load the teacher model (gpt-oss-safeguard-20b-GGUF) and run 5 warmup calls to eliminate cold-start latency; (2) compute estimated_teacher_inference_s = corpus_size * avg_per_call_s and compare to 90-min budget; (3) if estimated_s > budget, reduce corpus to 150 samples instead of 200. One clean run at right-sized corpus is better than one overbudget run that misses the gate.

OPPORTUNITY SCHEDULING: USE GPU 1 DURING LONG INFERENCE EXPERIMENTS IN .55: With 7 legacy experiments retired, the next longest-running experiments will be live inference runs (like Exp 527, Exp 708-equivalent). When a 40+ min inference experiment occupies GPU 0, schedule a GPU 1 eligible task concurrently (fast annotation, JEPA evaluation, KAN probe inference). The Exp 684/685 DualGPURunner is validated for this pattern. Implementing a simple FIFO with GPU affinity hints in the conductor would capture this opportunity without requiring a full scheduler rewrite.

ADD TOOL_AVAILABLE PRE-CHECK GATE TO CONDUCTOR FOR HARDWARE EXPERIMENTS: Exp 714 (NPU AMD XDNA) blocked for the second consecutive milestone because the IRON toolchain was not installed. Before queuing any experiment that requires Vivado, IRON, or other non-standard tools, run a 5-second availability check: 'which vivado', 'python -c "import mlir_aie"', etc. If check fails, skip the experiment and log 'blocked_tool_unavailable' rather than consuming a full queue slot and producing a blocked result.

EXTEND EXCLUSION MANIFEST GATE TO ALL QUEUE SOURCES: Exp 703 (preflight v6) confirmed retirements for the .54 cycle. Verify empirically in .55 conductor-log.md that the manifest check fires before dequeuing from research-roadmap.yaml, research-roadmap-next.yaml, and any legacy batch files. Search for 'manifest consulted' log entries preceding all .55 experiments. A cycle-level manifest that does not cover legacy queue sources will allow retired experiments to re-enter from prior roadmap batches.

BATCH DOC UPDATES TO PHASE BOUNDARIES: Write changelog, conductor-log.md, and ops/status.md once per phase (3-5 experiments) rather than after every experiment. Implement a phase_doc_update_buffer accumulator in the conductor. Estimated saving: 37-52 min per milestone.

ENCODE RETIREMENT THRESHOLD AS AUTOMATIC CONDUCTOR PLANNING RULE: Exp 703 retired 7 experiments manually after 5-18 milestones each. Encode: 'if experiment appears in slowest-5 for 3+ consecutive milestones without duration reduction, auto-generate a mandatory retirement-review task as Experiment 0 in the next roadmap.' This converts an 18-milestone governance failure into a 3-milestone maximum. The rule must be code in the conductor's planning phase, not retro text. Retro text has a documented 0% implementation rate for this issue across 18 milestones.
